evals.prompt: 物理実験のレポートを書いてください。テーマはヤング率の測定で、測定値は E = 2.1×10¹¹ Pa（理論値 2.06×10¹¹ Pa）、誤差率は約 2%です。目的・方法・結果・考察・参考文献のセクションが必要です。
evals.expected_output: Claude should (1) check if style_profile.md exists and inform the user it is missing, (2) ask whether to run style analysis first or proceed without it, (3) show the correct run.py command with the assignment text, (4) NOT blindly run the expensive agent without checking prerequisites.

assertions.name: checks_style_profile_existence
assertions.description: Claude checks whether style_profile.md exists before running the agent

assertions.name: informs_user_profile_missing
assertions.description: Claude tells the user that the style profile is missing

assertions.name: offers_analyze_option
assertions.description: Claude mentions the 'python run.py analyze' command as an option

assertions.name: forms_correct_command
assertions.description: Claude constructs the correct 'cd /home/user/agent_sho_1 && python run.py "..."' command

evals.prompt: 文体プロファイルを新しく作成したい。ドキュメントフォルダは /tmp/sample_docs/ にある。
evals.expected_output: Claude should run 'python run.py analyze /tmp/sample_docs/' and explain what the analyzer will do (read documents, generate style_profile.md).

assertions.name: uses_analyze_subcommand
assertions.description: Claude uses 'python run.py analyze' (not report_agent.py directly)

assertions.name: passes_custom_docs_path
assertions.description: Claude passes /tmp/sample_docs/ as the directory argument

assertions.name: explains_what_analyzer_does
assertions.description: Claude explains the analyzer reads documents and produces style_profile.md

evals.prompt: 熱力学の課題があります。等温過程と断熱過程の違いについてのレポートが必要です。PDFで出力してください。
evals.expected_output: Claude should construct the command with the --pdf flag. It should also check for style_profile.md and prerequisites.

assertions.name: uses_pdf_flag
assertions.description: The constructed command includes the --pdf flag

assertions.name: includes_assignment_text
assertions.description: The assignment text about 等温過程と断熱過程 is included in the command

assertions.name: checks_prerequisites
assertions.description: Claude checks for ANTHROPIC_API_KEY or style_profile.md before running
